about: I tend to obsess over privacy, security, anonymity, systems and automation.
What interests me most is understanding what happens underneath the interface: where identity leaks, trust accumulates, assumptions break and complex systems reveal their real behavior.
Browsers, networks, cryptography, low-level software and infrastructure are where that curiosity usually ends up.

projects.name: THOTH Browser
projects.summary: A browser project built around isolation, anti-correlation thinking and a much higher privacy standard.

projects.name: RelayX
projects.summary: A relay-oriented project built around separation, cleaner routing logic and privacy-minded design.
